About.label: Our story
About.title: Where flowers become memories
About.intro: Decore is a luxury floral studio and event decoration house in Ethiopia. We craft arrangements and full-venue experiences for weddings, celebrations, and the quiet moments that matter.
About.beautyText: Every stem is chosen with purpose. We design for impact and feeling.
About.loveText: From a proposal to an anniversary, we help you say what words cannot.
About.celebrationText: Weddings, graduations, traditional ceremonies — we elevate every occasion.
About.luxuryText: Premium materials, refined style, and service that feels personal.
About.rootedText: We understand Habesha ceremonies, local venues, and the colours and blooms that feel like home. Delivery in Addis Ababa and major cities, with Telebirr and bank transfer when you need them.

FAQ.label: Help
FAQ.title: Frequently asked questions
FAQ.subtitle: Quick answers about orders, delivery, and decorations
FAQ.stillHint: We're happy to help by phone, WhatsApp, or email.
FAQ.q1: Which cities do you deliver to?
FAQ.a1: We deliver in Addis Ababa and major cities such as Bahir Dar, Gondar, Hawassa, Mekelle, Dire Dawa, Adama and others. Delivery fees vary by location; orders over 3,000 ETB in Addis Ababa often get free delivery.
FAQ.q2: How far in advance should I book event decorations?
FAQ.a2: For weddings and large events we recommend booking at least 2–4 weeks ahead. Smaller arrangements can often be done with a few days' notice, depending on season and flower availability.
FAQ.q3: Can I customise a design from the gallery?
FAQ.a3: Yes. Use «Customise similar» on any design page, or our custom design builder to choose occasion, flowers, colours, size and extras. We'll confirm details and pricing with you.
FAQ.q4: Which payment methods do you accept?
FAQ.a4: Cash on delivery and bank transfer are available now. Telebirr and CBE Birr may be enabled soon. We'll confirm payment details when your order is accepted.
FAQ.q5: Do you offer traditional Ethiopian ceremony decorations?
FAQ.a5: Absolutely. We work in Habesha and traditional ceremony styles — stage, entrance, table and full venue — with respect for cultural details and colour preferences.
FAQ.q6: How do I track my order?
FAQ.a6: After checkout you'll receive an order number. Sign in to your account and open «My orders» to see status updates: pending, confirmed, preparing, ready, out for delivery, and completed.
FAQ.q7: Can I include a gift message?
FAQ.a7: Yes. Add a note at checkout or when building a custom design. Greeting cards and custom message cards are available as extras.
FAQ.q8: What if I need to change or cancel an order?
FAQ.a8: Contact us as soon as possible by phone or WhatsApp. Changes and cancellations depend on how far preparation has gone; we always try to accommodate.
